description: the docs index: search, proactive surfacing, memory, and the skills, rules and MCP-docs indexes

slash.name: rag
slash.description: raglit, an add-on: its own document indexes (attached ones, include, the UI), searched with docs_search; this project's code and docs are dund's project index, with no /rag on
slash.help:
Document indexes (raglit) are an add-on: raglit's own indexes, the ones attached to this workspace (/rag attach), what include and add-document read, and raglit's UI. The project index needs no /rag on: dund indexes this project's code and docs in every session, with /remember's notes and the session's folded history, and the model searches them with search (and session_search). While raglit is on, dun gives the model the parts of its indexes that bear on each question, and the model reads them with docs_search.
/rag on — turn it on for this session
/rag auto — turn it on in every session of this project
/rag off, /rag manual — the same two, to turn it off
/rag alone — whether it is on, and what it has read

include.help: FILE|DIR... — add to this workspace's index and keep up to date: a directory is WATCHED (raglit re-reads changed and new files); a file is read once. add-document reads a directory once, without watching

add-document.help: FILE|DIR... — read into this workspace's index ONCE: a directory's files as they are now; later changes and new files are not read (include watches a directory)

exclude.help: GLOB [--keep] — stop indexing paths that match GLOB in this workspace's index, and remove the ones indexed (--keep: only stop new ones). GLOB matches the absolute path (**/build/** is a directory anywhere); a GLOB with no / matches the file name (*.log)

unexclude.help: GLOB — index paths that match GLOB again (an exclude's GLOB, as typed); removed documents come back at raglit's next read of a watched directory, or with include or add-document

excludes.help: this workspace's index: its exclude GLOBs (ignore), the builtin ones, and allow (exempt from builtin)

prune.help: [--yes] — documents whose file is gone (a deleted worktree, a removed directory) are already out of search; list them per directory in this workspace's index, and with --yes remove them
